name: pogo-showdown

scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug -q && ls -la app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk
scripts.android:release: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease assembleRelease -q && ls -la app/build/outputs/bundle/release/ app/build/outputs/apk/release/

description: Open-world pogo action game: dig, build, duel, trick, dash and fight through the Forever Realm
